name: Gallatin River (Canyon)
gaugeName: Gallatin above Deer Creek nr Big Sky
blurb: Highway 191 whitewater. House Rock and the Mad Mile — rafts and experienced kayakers only.

sections.notes: Screaming Left, House Rock, Mad Mile. Not a tube or beginner run. Confirm the exact legal launch and take-out with the Forest Service or a local outfitter before going.
sections.accessReview: Greek Creek Campground now has a restored rock-terrace river access (completed May 2025), but the project documentation does not identify a designated raft launch. The older survey also distinguishes the campground from an upstream pull-out and Upper from Lower Storm Castle. Confirm the intended launch and take-out before mapping or using the old mileage.
sections.distanceReview: The 2015 access survey totals about 5.2 miles from Greek Creek Campground to Upper Storm Castle, or 7.3 miles to Lower Storm Castle. Neither supports the existing 9-mile label; select the current landings before publishing a replacement distance.

notices.title: Greek Creek access has changed
notices.text: The Gallatin River Task Force completed streambank restoration at Greek Creek in 2025, with a designated rock-terrace access and protective fencing. An old raft-launch pin may no longer identify the appropriate access. Confirm the designated launch before using this listing.
notices.sourceName: Gallatin River Task Force — Greek Creek restoration

notices.title: Greek Creek access changed
notices.text: The Task Force and Forest Service restoration added a designated rock terrace, fencing and bank stabilization. Use the signed access and protect restored banks; a confirmed raft launch-to-take-out pairing is still under review.
notices.sourceName: Gallatin River Task Force — Greek Creek restoration

mapAuditNote: Reviewed 2026-10-28. The access survey distinguishes two Greek Creek points and two Storm Castle points. Greek Creek was restored in 2024–2025; current raft access must be reconciled. Survey mileage also contradicts the old 9-mile figure. Map and timing remain held.
